note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: How many visitors below age 30 are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM visitor WHERE age  <  30

questions.question: Find the id and name of the museum that has the most staff members?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT museum_id ,  name FROM museum ORDER BY num_of_staff DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the average number of staff working for the museums that were open before 2009.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year  <  2009

questions.question: find the id, name and age for visitors who visited some museums more than once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.id ,  t1.name ,  t1.age FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id GROUP BY t1.id HAVING count(*)  >  1

questions.question: What are the id and name of the museum visited most times?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t2.Museum_ID ,  t1.name FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID GROUP BY t2.Museum_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the number of visitors who did not visit any museum opened after 2010.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM visitor WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT t2.visitor_id FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t1.open_year  >  2010)
